changelog.summary: Scaffolded — 6 domains, index.json grounded in the official GH-600 study guide (Microsoft Learn)
Domain 2: 28 questions + notes added (tool config, MCP servers, environment integration, error handling).
Domain 3: 14 questions added (memory strategies, state persistence & drift, cross-tool continuity).
Domain 4: 22 questions added (success criteria & evaluation signals, failure root-cause analysis, tuning agent behavior).
Domain 5: 20 questions added (orchestration patterns & isolation, observability & audit trails, failure detection & recovery, agent lifecycle management).
Domain 6: 14 questions added (autonomy-level classification, guardrails & human-in-the-loop workflows).

6 scenarios added: SDLC-integrated PR review agent, MCP tooling & permission scoping, cross-session memory & context drift, evaluation & tuning pipeline, multi-agent parallel execution, guardrails & human-in-the-loop.

Extracted the embedded 'Worked scenario' prose from all 6 domain notes files into 6 dedicated RichScenario v2.0 files (gh600-scenario-007..012), each with 4 scenario-specific questions and keyLearnings, matching the platform's scenarios/ convention. Notes files now link out to Scenario Practice instead of duplicating the walkthrough inline.

Added taxonomyIds to 6 domain(s) — cross-vertical relationship discovery metadata (IDEA-0008 Phase 4), aggregated + alias-resolved from each domain's own question tags. No question/notes/scenario content changed.

Diagram-craft QA pass (mermaid-diagram-craft/SKILL.md): fixed 6 of 11 diagrams with real violations — reconnected an orphan subgraph in D1's delegation diagram, shortened 4 over-length node labels (D2, D4 x2, D6), shortened 2 over-length edge labels (D1, D4). Added an italic caption line below all 11 diagrams platform-wide had none — the markdown-notes stopgap convention documented in the same skill file. First-draft captions on 7 of the 11 diagrams exceeded the skill's own 5-10 word rule (caught on a second QA pass); all 11 now verified within range. No prose/content changed.

Syllabus and fact refresh. Checked against the GH-600 study guide (learn.microsoft.com, page dated 2026-05-04): domains, weights and objectives unchanged. Renamed Copilot coding agent to Copilot cloud agent across notes, questions and scenarios. Corrected outdated facts against docs.github.com: cloud agent secrets are now Agents secrets and variables (not a copilot environment); MCP registry/allowlist policies do not apply to cloud agent (MCP servers in Copilot policy does), and the recommended client allowlist is managed-settings.json; MCP config types and required tools key; firewall scope excludes setup steps and MCP servers; 59-minute session limit; workflow-approval setting is repository-wide; excludedTools is a Copilot SDK session/defaultAgent setting. Rewrote gh600-d2-013, d2-021, d2-022 and tightened d1-013, d2-014, d3-013. Added 13 questions (d1-023, d2-029..035, d3-015..017, d6-015..016) and notes sections on Copilot Memory (D3) and cloud agent built-in guardrails (D6). Scenario correct-answer positions rebalanced; gh600-d2-005 rewritten (a custom agent's tools list selects tools, not paths); d5-011/d5-012 timings aligned with the 59-minute cloud-agent session limit.
